svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rip a strip 1,050 x 52.5 mm from 12 mm exterior plywood.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Five feed openings, one per wick strip, 33 mm tall from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge. From the centre line, the same each side (mm):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle opening 89 each side of centre; others 106 to 283; 300 to 481.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 10 mm hole in each top corner of an opening, cut down to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom edge with a jigsaw, file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The posts left between openings are about 17 mm wide, on the rib

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lines; handle the wall flat until it is in the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the stone wool liner for this wall with the same openings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: between the side walls, its bottom edge on the base ring.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The wick tails pass out through the openings to the trough.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: openings line up with the wick strip positions.
